newsitem.title: UK: Oil inspector Petrak opens Ceyhan, Turkey office.
newsitem.headline: Oil inspector Petrak opens Ceyhan, Turkey office.

text.p: Leading oil inspector Petrak said on Thursday it had opened an office at Turkey's pipeline terminal Ceyhan, the main outlet for Iraqi crude exports.
Petrak said it had stationed its mobile laboratory Docksider in Ceyhan to offer potential buyers of Iraqi crude an inspection service.
The laboratory is equipped to carry out tests on density, water content, pour point and sulphur.
Petrak is in place at Ceyhan in time for the resumption of the second phase of Iraqi crude exports under a U.N. oil-for-food exchange.
Iraq is expected shortly to restart exports under the deal and is thought capable of piping up to 700,000 barrels a day (bpd) of its Kirkuk blend to Ceyhan.
